issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type String, but the reference solution (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) defines getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return int. This discrepancy (UML:String vs implementation:int) will confuse students: the textual hint in the task points them to the UML for the expected return type, but the provided solution and tests expect an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across materials. Preferred fix: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int and update the textual hint that points students to the UML. Alternatively, if the intended API is String, change the reference implementation and any tests to return String. Apply the same change everywhere (UML, problem text, tests, and example output) so students have a single correct expectation.
